title: Term Life Insurance Policy Fee Share for Owners of Ashgrove Permanent Life Policies — Quarterly Billing Conversion
content:
**Relationship terms.** In the converted quarterly installment of a Term Life Insurance policy — the installment set when the policy is converted to quarterly direct billing after its monthly bank-draft privilege ends — the share of the policy fee charged follows the owner's other Ashgrove life policies: in-force Whole Life Insurance policies and in-force Universal Life Insurance policies held by the same owner.

| Owner's other Ashgrove life policies (status in force) | Policy fee share charged |
|---|---|
| Both an Ashgrove whole life policy (Whole Life Insurance) and an Ashgrove universal life policy (Universal Life Insurance) | nothing of the fee |
| Exactly one of the two | one half (0.5) of the fee |
| Neither | the whole of the fee |

The share is read from the owner's whole life and universal life policy records: only a policy whose status is in force counts; a surrendered, lapsed or otherwise closed permanent policy does not.

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Owner holds an in-force Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 and no universal life policy: one half of the fee.
- Owner holds an in-force Ashgrove Protection UL and an in-force Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life: nothing of the fee.
- Owner's only whole life policy was surrendered last year: the whole of the fee.
